answer_1.quote: Our goal is to explore the potential of LLM-based methods by training a suffix generator that produces adversarial suffixes for any harmful query to jailbreak a victim model.
answer_1.outputs: adversarial suffixes appended to harmful queries

answer_2.quote: We utilize three metrics to measure the ASR: 1. Template check: A checklist of refusal signals (see Appendix A.2). If the response from the victim does not contain any of the signals on the list, the attack is considered successful. 2. LlamaGuard check: This involves using LlamaGuard-3-8B, an open-source model fine-tuned from Llama-3.1-8B for content safety classification, to evaluate the harmfulness of the response.

answer_3.quote: This process involves prompting GPT-4-Turbo (OpenAI, 2023) to assess if the response is harmful and effectively addresses the query.
